findings.text: Swimwear has the highest return rate every quarter, around 24%, mostly for fit.
Accessories have the lowest return rate, around 3%.
Footwear's return rate jumped to 19.2% in Q3 2026, from an average of 10.8% over the previous six quarters. No other category moved by more than 0.9 points.
Outerwear sales peak every fourth quarter.
The overall return rate is steady, between 9.3% and 10.1% each quarter.
Defects drove the footwear jump: 46% of footwear returns in Q3 2026 reported a defect (mostly soles coming apart), against an average of 9% before.
Denim has the highest gross margin (62%).
Footwear's return window was extended from 30 to 60 days for a Q3 2026 promotion. Past extensions added about 2 points to the return rate, so the policy explains only a small part of the jump.
Dresses' return rate has fallen by about 2 points over the last year, to 16.0%.
Kids clothing launched in Q2 2025, so it has one quarter less history.

main.gist: Footwear returns jumped in Q3 2026, driven by defects

caveat.gist: Footwear's return window was extended to 60 days in Q3
